description: This file defines the EvaluationRunner class responsible for managing evaluation processes, including fetching model cost metrics, running evaluations, and handling API interactions with axios.

classes.name: EvaluationRunner
classes.description: A class that manages evaluation workflows, including metric collection, API calls, and evaluation data processing.

methods.name: getCostMetrics
methods.description: Fetches cost-related metrics for a given provider and model.

methods.name: getAndDeleteMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves and removes metrics associated with a specific ID, optionally fetching cost metrics.

methods.name: addMetrics
methods.description: Adds a metric string to the metrics map under a specific ID.

methods.name: runEvaluations
methods.description: Runs evaluation processes on provided data, handling multiple chatflow IDs.

methods.name: evaluateChatflow
methods.description: Performs evaluation of a specific chatflow, making API calls, processing responses, and handling errors.

methods.name: getChatflowApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves the API key for a given chatflow ID from a list of API keys.
